meeting-notes.compatibility_rationale: Standalone meeting-notes adopts the fixture next exact pin when the stand-in release is digest-compatible with the shared baseline (same sha256 as 1.3.2).

loop.compatibility_rationale: Loop WF1 keeps the validated shared 1.3.2 pin until a real registry next release and BundleEmbedder host proof exist; remain is an explicit per-app choice, not a floating range.

meeting-notes.rationale: When the baseline pin is fixture-deprecated, meeting-notes migrates to the stand-in next pin already chosen at pin-flip.

loop.rationale: Loop continues pinning the immutable digest while recording fixture deprecation; continue_pinning is a supported consumer response (not invented registry policy).
